segments.speaker: aartcc
segments.text: 5:39:10 JAL1628 heavy, roger, at your discretion proceed direct to Talkeetna J125, Anchorage. (Note: J125 is a flight route.)

segments.speaker: aartcc
segments.text: 5:39:35 JAL1628 heavy, roger sir. The military radar advises they do have a primary target in trail of you at this time.

segments.speaker: aartcc
segments.text: 5:39:35 JAl1628 heavy. Military radar advises they are picking up intermittent primary target behind you in trail, in trail I say again.
